title: Rig Relay Repository Workspace Eligibility v1
description: Standalone workspace eligibility assessment consumed by Y1 workspace allocation. Determines whether a repository is safe and ready for agent workspace creation, with path-level policy for read, write, and forbidden operations.

release_id.description: Unique identifier linking to the RepositoryContextRelease that produced this assessment.

eligible.description: True when the repository meets all workspace eligibility criteria.

recommended_workspace_kind.description: Recommended workspace kind: read_only, managed_write, etc.

path_policy.description: Per-path policy mapping: path -> read, write, or forbidden.

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when eligibility was evaluated.

eligibility_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the canonical eligibility assessment JSON.
